source.publisher: BEAR benchmark, Vienna University of Economics and Business (WU), QADLOD project (Fernández, Umbrich, Polleres, Knuth)
source.title: BEAR-B (DBpedia Live, 100 most volatile resources, Aug-Oct 2015), day granularity
source.license: Data derived from DBpedia (CC BY-SA 3.0 and GNU FDL); the BEAR page states no separate data license (verified 2026-10-06); BEAR code is LGPL-3.0
source.attribution: BEAR: Fernández, Umbrich, Polleres, Knuth, 'Evaluating query and storage strategies for RDF archives', Semantic Web Journal (2019); data from DBpedia Live (DBpedia Association) and Wikipedia contributors
source.redistribution: not reviewed for redistribution: raw archives and extracted triples are cached locally or as CI cache entries and never committed

extraction.algorithm: BEAR-B day: TB/CB changeset lineage, anchored at IC version 1, canonical N-Quads, 12-version max-change window

parameters.window_rule: max adds+deletes over consecutive versions; lowest start on ties

extraction.range: day versions v22..=v33 (0-based TB numbering; IC files 000023..000034) of v0..=v88
